narrative.intro: Fluor Intercontinental has $279M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date, across 13 awards with an average award size of $21.5M. Obligations in FY2026 are up 89.2% year over year. Historical obligations show variability: FY21 obligations were $286M, FY22 obligations were $313M, FY23 obligations were $34.6M, FY24 obligations were $142M, and FY25 obligations were $148M. Facilities Support Services is the dominant NAICS market in FY2026 to date with $279M in obligations. The dataset reports one NAICS market with $0 in obligations: All Other Professional, Scientific, and Technical Services. The reporting period is FY2026 to date, and the totals are partial because current-year totals are fiscal year to date. The figures are contract obligations except where tables list award-value figures as total contract values. Use the award count and average award size to gauge contract scale and the fiscal-year series to track recent volatility in annual obligations.
